decisions.reason: The contract-ID status does not change agreement dates; the source message's separate date-field instruction is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Missing NCA and 286R contract IDs do not alter the supplied allocated-budget amounts or their value source.
The contract-ID decision does not change the allocation rule or approved non-personnel lines; those are established by a separate clause in the source message.
The absence of contract IDs does not change the previously established seven-week Annex B value.
The NCA contract ID being unavailable does not change the established equivalence between NCA and NH.

The consequence of the missing 286R contract ID—using 286R as the document designation—is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, with no additional attribute or removal required.
Contract-ID availability does not change the existing Harborview or MS 284 weekdays and session times; the source supplies no replacement schedule values.
The missing contract IDs do not affect whether or where the subcontractor signature is required.
Contract-ID status does not alter the session-based compensation formula, HPI session count, per-session charge, or personnel total.
